## Screen reference

SR2 unlocks immediately after Mission 1 completes. The screen below is the earth base state at that moment — this is where the unlock copy and CTA will appear (top area / overlay):

![Earth base post-Mission 1 — SR2 unlock trigger point](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Signal-K/planet-hunters-experiment-1/main/e2e/screenshots/ux-tour-earth-base-post-m1.png)

Visible elements for context: francs counter (top-left), bottom nav bar (Back / Next / Menu / Market / Map / New Mission), earth base buildings in background.

snapshot.title: Write copy and flow for the Starter Rocket 2 unlock screen
snapshot.description: When a player hits level 3, SR2 unlocks but nothing meaningful happens. Write the screen copy — headline, what stats to highlight (2x speed, 2x range, 1.5x cargo), and the CTA. Also describe the visual flow: what shows on screen, in what order, for how long. This is the spec the developer needs to implement it.
